title: "Learn how to play with people, not for people"
summary: Jones says the drummer must listen and play with people before playing for an audience, and that Walter Page and the bass taught him.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I didn't play, Milt. All I was doing was sitting there listening. It was things like what I did with you or what I did with Teddy. I was always an audience. I will be an audience as long as I live.
How do you mean that, Jo?

It's very difficult to teach people how to play with people, not for people. Because to be able to sit up on the bandstand and play with the people that you play with and sit and listen - the drum is a very unique instrument since it is the first. You sit and listen to learn how to play with people before you play for people. It's an automatic thing if you're going to play for an audience, you got people out there. You know I told you a long time ago I didn't know nothing about the drum. I had to learn how to play the drum from Mr. Walter Page. Without the bass fiddle I don't know how to play. The bass is the foundation. That's the reason I always refer to you as 'Section.' That's the reason I ask you. I'm not asking from the trumpet player, the saxophone player, the trombone player, the violin player - I have to ask you where I'm going. You and I both have been fortunate enough to play around peoples that lived in a certain way that we can do this thing. Somehow coming out of what you're talking about, it's very difficult to explain how
that Buck Clayton, Milt Hinton, Joe Bushkin, and myself can sit down tonight and play as though we just played yesterday.
Music is just that close, yes. We understand each other. Our lives are intermingled... with our music

That's the word, that's the keyword is understanding. Learn how to play with people, not for people. We were very fortunate. It's impossible, and we would love to impart this to the youngsters, to learn how to play with people, nqt just sit at home and listen to the records or read the: write-ups, just to learn how to play with peoples.
